name: What is the typical process for stucco re-coating?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for stucco re-coating?

acceptedAnswer.text: The stucco re-coating process typically begins with a thorough cleaning of the existing stucco surface to remove dirt, mildew, and loose debris. Any significant cracks or damaged areas are then repaired and allowed to cure. Next, a primer may be applied to ensure proper adhesion. Finally, one or more coats of the specialized stucco re-coating material are applied, creating a fresh, uniform, and protective finish. Drying times vary depending on the product and weather conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: The stucco re-coating process involves cleaning, repairing, priming (if needed), and then applying new re-coating material to the surface.
